change_summary: Strengthened existing learning tests and added focused log-target clipping and prediction-alignment tests. Production implementation, parser, configuration, dependencies, and official scripts remain unchanged.
coverage: Fixed 400-tree/min_samples_leaf=2/max_features=1.0/n_jobs=4 ExtraTrees fixtures verify parameter forwarding and seeds 42/43.

Asymmetric synthetic training features distinguish median from mean imputation; all-nonfinite columns use the installed imputer's zero fallback. Numeric threshold and log2_threshold remain in the training vocabulary.

Before/after joblib hashes cover the full fitted estimator, vocabulary, imputer statistics, tree state, threshold medians and global median across extreme held-out values, novel keys, unseen thresholds and missing features. Training predictions also remain stable.
Median baseline clips seconds before threshold/global aggregation; shuffled prediction thresholds verify alignment and unseen-threshold fallback.
Known constant tree leaves verify log10 training and reconstruction of clipped seconds, including targets below 1e-9 and above the six-hour cap.
Median and tree estimators round-trip through joblib and root model.RuntimeModel; batch and scalar adapter predictions agree. Missing artifacts raise FileNotFoundError.
Both baseline estimator kinds return finite float arrays in [1e-9,21600], including empty output, and reject mismatched inference counts.
Inspected public parameter names, root adapter identity and optional artifacts_dir default remain as supplied.

import importlib.metadata as metadata
import json
import platform
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tomllib

locked = []
for line in Path("requirements.lock.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
    if not line or line.startswith("#"):
        continue
    name, expected = line.split("==", 1)
    try:
        installed = metadata.version(name)
    except metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
        installed = None
    locked.append({"name": name, "expected": expected, "installed": installed, "matches_lock": installed == expected})
paths = ["model_config.json", "model.py", "runtime_pipeline/learning.py", "runtime_pipeline/model.py", "runtime_pipeline/parser.py", "run.py", "score.py", "requirements.lock.txt", "pyproject.toml"]
print(json.dumps({"python_executable": sys.executable, "python_version": platform.python_version(), "requires_python": project["requires-python"], "declared_dependencies": project["dependencies"], "locked_dependencies": locked, "sha256": {p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}}, indent=2))
'@
